title: ODS Detect Output v1
description: Output of `ods detect --json`: the result of AI code detection across commit trailers, branch names, PR descriptions, and diff heuristics.

confidence.description: Aggregate detection confidence: the highest individual signal plus 0.05 per additional distinct source (commit-trailer, git-ai-notes, pr-body, branch-name, diff-heuristics), capped at 0.95. Several signals from one source — five attributed commits — count once. Attribution is volunteered by tools and authors, never proven, so certainty (1.0) is never reported.

files.description: Per-file detection results from diff heuristics. Omitted when no files were fingerprinted.

evidence.description: Individual signals that contributed to the verdict.

sources.description: Names of the signal sources that fired (e.g. commit-trailer, branch-name, pr-body, diff-heuristics).

ai_lines.description: AI lines in the file: measured (git-ai authorship notes), attested (the code lines AI-attributed commits added, capped at the file's insertions in the diff), or estimated (diff heuristics), in that order of preference.

total_lines.description: Total lines considered in the file.

value.description: Human-readable description of the matched signal.
